Rashi on Bava Metzia 16a:1:1.hebrew: הא מית - לוקח, ומי יחרפנו עוד? הלכך לא נתכוון לזה אלא להעמידה בידו בחייו, ולא לאחר מותו. מ"ד כו':
Rashi on Bava Metzia 16a:1:1.english: Behold, he died - The purchaser [died], and who will revile him anymore? Therefore, he did not intend this except to maintain it in his [the purchaser's] possession during his lifetime, and not after his death. [And as for] the one who says, etc.
